title: Agricultural biotechnology approval and bargaining move ledger
unit_policy: A move may be an administrative act, publication, negotiated undertaking, company response or attributed allegation. Event type and evidentiary status prevent counting every row as a Chinese concession.
date_policy: Validity-period starts, signing, publication and launch announcements are distinct. Reported application months/years retain their limited precision. No invented exact day.
selection_policy: Purposive pre/post comparison of two old applications and one renewal; not a matched sample, no complete post-2020 cohort, no standalone estimate of causal delay.

moves.event: Authorizes unconfined environmental release and livestock-feed use of canola event 73496.
moves.permission_use: Canadian cultivation/environment and feed; not Chinese import permission
moves.interpretive_limit: Same-event regulatory comparison; does not establish when China accepted a dossier.
missing_records: Separate food permission not established from this source

moves.interpretive_limit: Same central premise and some language, with substantial rewriting and explicit new-plan acknowledgment. No verbatim adoption or proven author of changes; no additional deadline/enforcement procedure in this exchange.

moves.actor: US negotiators, as described by Reuters sources
moves.event: US pressure for further Chinese biotechnology approvals reported as part of trade-deal discussions.
moves.product_event: Sector-wide; Enlist E3 discussed as example
moves.evidentiary_status: contemporary reporting based on unnamed sources

moves.event: Original Enlist E3 processing-import certificate effective; listed as 2018 No. 005.
moves.interpretive_limit: Effective date is not necessarily signing, NBC recommendation or delivery date. Predates Phase One.

moves.actor: MARA publication; Reuters and DTN reporting; Corteva response
moves.event: Five new approvals publicly reported; Corteva says it awaits official certificates. DP73496 still appears in Reuters pending list.
moves.evidentiary_status: official list plus contemporaneous participant reporting
moves.interpretive_limit: January talks coincide with publication; cannot assume they caused an authorization already effective in December. Pending does not mean denied.

moves.event: Announce 2019 broad US Enlist E3 launch following Philippine import authorization.
moves.permission_use: US seed commercialization following multi-market authorizations
moves.interpretive_limit: Establishes company’s announced launch gate; does not independently measure seed sales, planting or economic loss. China was not the last reported permission.
missing_records: Philippine original decision and service record

moves.event: Sign Phase One; Annex 16 sets average 24-month formal submission-to-final-decision obligation and detailed administrative obligations; Chapter 3 footnote excludes Article 8.5 application to implementing measures.
moves.permission_use: Feed/processing review plus specified other biotechnology provisions
moves.interpretive_limit: Average covers approving or disapproving decisions, not guaranteed approval of each event. Earlier obligations already detailed. No application cohort inferred.

moves.event: Favorable DP73496 assessment adopted, as recorded in final EU decision.
moves.permission_use: EU food/feed and specified non-cultivation uses
moves.evidentiary_status: official later decision recites assessment date
moves.interpretive_limit: Original scientific assessment not independently read; event timing only, not new safety conclusion.

moves.event: Five-year Enlist E3 renewal period begins, ending 2026-12-16; No. 319 explicitly marked renewal.
moves.interpretive_limit: Bounded positive evidence consistent with five-year authorization provision. Neither first-time approval nor evidence about new-application speed.

moves.date_precision: day inferred from dated official hosting path
moves.event: Publishes/hosts December 2021 import list containing Enlist E3 renewal.
moves.interpretive_limit: Publication after old expiry does not establish delayed delivery or disrupted trade; validity starts before old expiry.
missing_records: Actual certificate service and shipment documentation

moves.event: Authorizes DP73496 after 2012 application; decision records no opinion from Standing and Appeal Committees and excludes cultivation.
moves.permission_use: EU food/feed and other non-cultivation uses
moves.interpretive_limit: Long same-event EU process prevents attributing the entire development-to-launch interval exclusively to Chinese review. Final-decision gap is not a causal delay estimate.

moves.event: Original DP73496 import-processing certificate takes effect through 2028-01-04, listed under 2022 No. 053.
moves.interpretive_limit: Reported submission-to-validity interval roughly ten and a half years, but no individual dossier or net launch-delay estimate.

moves.actor: MARA publication; Corteva and US officials respond
moves.event: Publishes eight new import event approvals and two renewals; Reuters reports DP73496 and company work toward remaining approvals.
moves.product_event: DP73496 and other named batch events
moves.interpretive_limit: Consultant’s goodwill-after-Bali explanation is an interpretation, not a recovered political instruction. Batch includes non-US developers.

moves.actor: Corteva’s Jeff Loessin, interviewed by Western Producer
moves.event: Says China was final needed global approval and describes stewardship/industry communication before launch.
moves.permission_use: Global commercialization planning after regulatory clearance
moves.interpretive_limit: Separates final clearance from actual launch; updated article has no recovered changelog.
missing_records: Internal launch decision and readiness records

moves.event: Announces Canadian and US 2023 commercial launch; Australia 2023 demonstrations and 2024 full launch.
moves.interpretive_limit: Announced plans are not independent evidence of realized planting or revenues.
missing_records: Actual market launch and planting data

moves.actor: State Council Information Office / MOFCOM-hosted white paper
moves.event: Defends agricultural implementation through examples of restored food and crop access.
moves.interpretive_limit: Selected subsection offers no event-level adjudication of these biotech cases; not a response to later 2026 claims.

moves.event: Claims 69-month average approval time and two products pending at least nine years; describes process uncertainty and multi-market launch gates.
moves.interpretive_limit: No disclosed cohort; no independently established approval-linked theft in answers. Repetition of industry complaints is not independent proof of Chinese intent.
missing_records: Specific correspondence and alleged appropriation evidence

moves.event: Reports continuing failure of average-time obligation, opaque procedures and nonpublication of 2025 NBC meeting outcomes; acknowledges some foreign approvals.
moves.interpretive_limit: Publication gap limits reconstruction; not proof there were no approvals. Domestic cultivation counts not matched import-approval comparator.

moves.event: Publishes summit account saying China agreed to scientific review of biotechnology traits.
moves.interpretive_limit: Evidence that approval remains senior bargaining subject; no named certificate, deadline or fulfilled commitment. Underlying full broadcast not watched.
